_about: Single source of every design input of the workflow. All plain-Python scripts and the Abaqus model read this file through code/design_basis.py, so a change here propagates everywhere. The values are those of the thesis; edit them, or point the environment variable LH2_DESIGN_BASIS at a copy, to run a new study. Units are SI unless the key says otherwise.

mission._doc: Energy equivalence and tank sizing rule (thesis Section 3.1). The hydrogen mass carries the energy of the kerosene it replaces; the radius is a fixed fraction of the fuselage diameter; the barrel length follows from the volume at the mission fill level.

aircraft._doc: One record per tank. Mission inputs: jet_a_mass_kg and fuselage_diameter_m. Model geometry: R_mid_m and L_barrel_m; set both to null and they are derived from the mission inputs by tank_geometry_from_mission.py and design_basis.py (rounded to 0.1 mm). The thesis records keep the geometry exactly as analysed. Q_budget_W: null derives it from the heat_budget rule below. t_wall_initial_m is only the starting value of the FE sizing loop; the sized wall is read from results/sized_walls.csv.

E190.label: E190
E190.note: Kerosene mass derived in an earlier phase of the project from a tank volume of 80.10 m3, hence the barrel length was fixed from that volume.

A350.label: A350-900
A350.note: 166 000 L at 0.804 kg/L (Airbus A350 Family Facts and Figures, April 2025).

material._doc: Inner vessel, aluminium 2219-T87, room-temperature MIL-HDBK-5J values (thesis Table 3.3).
material.name: Al 2219-T87

criteria._doc: Reserve factors RF = allowable / applied with a project design margin in both allowables. The margin is not the CS-25 factor of safety (thesis Section 3.6). Buckling allowable: NASA SP-8007 knockdown, pressure stabilisation not credited.

pressures._doc: Absolute operating pressures and the two design pressure differences. Strength at p_design_gauge_Pa (3.6 % above venting for relief-valve tolerance); stability at p_fill_abs_Pa minus p_ambient_Pa, the pressure difference after a loss of vacuum at sea level.

thermal._doc: Thermal boundary conditions (Bagarello et al. Sec. 3.1) and the stress-free reference temperature (cold operating state).

heat_budget._doc: Rule used when an aircraft record has Q_budget_W = null: Q = boiloff_fraction_per_h x (V x rho_lh2) x h_fg / 3600. It equals a no-vent hold of 14.68 h between p_fill_abs_Pa and p_vent_abs_Pa for a tank sealed at hold_fill_level (boiloff_requirement_derivation.py derives this from the parahydrogen equation of state).

load_cases._doc: Load factors n = (nx forward, ny lateral, nz vertical) in g. The keys are the codes used in the results file names; label is the name used in the thesis. Add a case by adding a record.

analysis._doc: Case used to size the wall and for the mesh study, and the extraction and mesh rules (thesis Sections 4.4 and 4.7).
